plain.li: I'd like somewhere to put my things where they're still there in the morning.
[trigger:barracks] Somebody in there talks in their sleep. Last night it was about me. I want my own room.
[summer] That many bodies in one room in summer. You can smell the barracks from the fields.
[trait:NightOwl] I come to bed when everyone's asleep and leave when they wake. A room of my own would save us all the tiptoeing.

warm.li: I don't mind the barracks, really. I just hate waking everyone up with my nightmares.
[old] I'm up three times a night. The whole barracks knows it. A little room would spare them.
[trusting] You've been good to me so far. If a room ever comes free, I'd love it.

blunt.li: I want a room. With a door. That I can slam.
[trigger:barracks] Next person who steps on me in the dark loses the foot. Get me a room before it comes to that.
[trait:Abrasive] Everyone in the barracks hates me anyway. Move me out and you'll have a happier colony.

cheerful.li: I've been practicing what I'll say to visitors. "Welcome to my room!" Sounds great. I just need the room.
[spring] Spring cleaning idea: sweep me out of the barracks and into a room of my own!
[child] Can I have my own room? Like a grown-up? I'll keep my socks off the floor. Mostly.

gloomy.li: In the barracks you can't even cry quietly. Somebody always hears.
[bitter] I've given this place everything I had. It hasn't given me a door.
[night] Someone three beds down is grinding their teeth. Somewhere there's a room where I wouldn't hear it.

cold.li: People who sleep near me tend to get nervous. A private room solves their problem and mine.
[trigger:barracks] Barracks sleep is shallow sleep. Shallow sleep costs you hours of my work every week. Build the room.

plain.li: {FOR_nameDef} wakes up every time someone in the barracks turns over. A room of {FOR_possessive} own would fix that.

warm.li: {FOR_nameDef} has earned some quiet. A room with a door, maybe {THING} in it. I'll carry the stone myself.

blunt.li: {FOR_nameDef} is too proud to ask. I'm not. Give {FOR_objective} a room.

cold.li: {FOR_nameDef} sleeps badly in the barracks and works badly as a result. A private room is a cheap fix.

plain.li: I put my boots by the door. My door. They'll still be there tomorrow.
[trigger:barracks] I slept straight through. Nobody woke me. Nobody even could.
[forother] {PAWN_nameDef} asked for this on my behalf? I'll have to find a way to repay that.

warm.li: I'll leave the door open in the evenings. Anyone who wants to talk knows where to find me now.
[old] I've slept in a lot of places. This is the first in years that feels like mine.

blunt.li: Good. From now on, nobody comes in without knocking. Nobody.

cheerful.li: I've rearranged it four times already and it's been one afternoon!
[night] I can sing in here! Badly! And nobody can stop me!

gloomy.li: I closed the door and sat on the bed for an hour. Didn't do anything. Didn't have to.

cold.li: A locked door and uninterrupted sleep. My work will reflect it.

plain.li: I'll keep my valuables in my boots, then. Safest place in the barracks.
[promised] I told people I was getting a room. Now I get to tell them I'm not.
[forother] {FOR_nameDef} is still in the barracks. I asked. I'll ask again, but I did ask.

warm.li: Never mind. Somebody in the barracks has to hum the others to sleep, I suppose.
[trusting] I know there's a lot going on. I'm not angry, just tired.

blunt.li: Great. Back to sleeping between a snorer and a sleepwalker.
[bitter] Funny how the people who decide these things all have doors.

cheerful.li: Okay! Barracks life! Bunk buddies forever! ...I'm fine. Totally fine.

gloomy.li: You don't need a room to lie awake in. The barracks works for that.

cold.li: My sleep will suffer, so my work will suffer. That's on you now, not me.
[trait:Psychopath] If someone in the barracks wakes up with me standing over them, remember this conversation.

plain.li: Still in the barracks. Still thinking about a door with my name on it.
[trigger:barracks] Someone sneezed on me in my sleep. I'm only bringing it up because of the room.

warm.li: [forother] {FOR_nameDef} is still sleeping in the barracks. I haven't forgotten, even if everyone else has.

blunt.li: [bitter] Room. Me. Remember? Or is that too much to keep in your head?

gloomy.li: [winter] Another week of everyone's coughing. The room still doesn't exist, I take it.

cold.li: My room has not been built. I am keeping track of how long it has been.

plain.li: My room has a bed, a box and a crack in the wall shaped like a raider. I'd like it to have something else.
[trait:Jealous] I walked past the other bedrooms on the way to mine. I shouldn't have.
[skill:Construction] I've built half the rooms in this colony. Mine's the only one I'd be ashamed to show anyone.
[old] I've lived long enough to want my last rooms to be nice ones.

warm.li: A proper floor, something soft underfoot, a bit of color on the walls. I'd finally feel at home.
[trusting] I know you'll get to it. I just wanted you to know my room could use a little love.
[spring] Spring's here. I'd like my room to feel a little like it too. Some color, maybe.

blunt.li: My room looks like where we keep the bodies before burial. Do something about it.
[trait:Greedy] I work harder than half this colony and I sleep like a boomalope. Fix my room.
[rich] The storeroom's full of silver. My room's full of nothing. Spend some on me.

cheerful.li: What if, hear me out, my room had a statue of me in it? Too much? A statue of anything, then!
[highmood] I'm in such a good mood, I want my room to match. Let's make it fancy!
[trait:Beauty] A face like mine deserves a room like... well, not like this one!

gloomy.li: I don't need a beautiful room. I just want one that doesn't remind me where I am.
[winter] All winter I've stared at the same bare stone. I've started naming the cracks.
[repeat] I asked before. The room's still ugly. So am I, lately.

cold.li: Status is visible. Mine currently isn't. A better room corrects that.
[trait:Psychopath] People treat you differently when your room impresses them. More carefully. I'd like to be treated carefully.

plain.li: I gave someone a tour. Of my bedroom. Who am I now?
[morning] I woke up and didn't want to leave. That's never happened here.
[promised] I didn't really believe the promise. I'm glad I was wrong.

warm.li: It feels like a real home now. Come by anytime, I mean it.

blunt.li: [trait:Greedy] Now that's a room. Make sure the others see it.

cheerful.li: I keep walking in and gasping. Every time! It's exhausting and wonderful!

gloomy.li: Nicer walls to stare at when I can't sleep. That's an improvement. Honestly.
[lowmood] It's lovely. I'm not, today. But it's lovely.

cold.li: Good. People will notice. That was the point.
[trait:Greedy] The best room in the colony is mine now? Keep it that way.

plain.li: I'll hang a blanket on the wall and call it art.
[bitter] I've watched three bedrooms get furnished this season. None of them were mine.
[promised] I was told my room would be nicer. I went and looked. It isn't.

warm.li: It's still a roof over my head. I'll make it nice myself, a little at a time.
[trusting] I know you tried. Or I'll believe it, anyway.

blunt.li: [trait:Jealous] So the others get nice rooms and I get stone. Got it.

cheerful.li: Plain is a style too! A very plain style. That I'm choosing. Apparently.
[highmood] Ugly room, great mood! The mood wins today!

gloomy.li: Ugly room, ugly life. At least it's consistent.

cold.li: So my standards are not a priority. I'll lower my effort to match.

plain.li: My room still isn't what you'd call {SUBJECT}. Not even close.
[morning] Woke up to the same bare walls. Just mentioning it.

blunt.li: Has anybody even looked at my room since I asked? Go look. I'll wait.

cheerful.li: Still dreaming about {WISH}! It'll happen. I've decided.

gloomy.li: [trait:Jealous] I walked past another nice room today. Not mine, obviously.

warm.li: Whenever there's time, my room could still use a kinder floor and a little color.

plain.li: I have to climb over the bed to reach the door. Every single time.
[skill:Melee] I can't stretch in there without punching the wall. I did punch the wall. Twice.
[winter] I'm spending the whole winter indoors in a closet. A few more steps of floor, please.

warm.li: I'd love just enough room for a chair, so a friend could sit with me in the evenings.
[old] My hips don't turn the way they used to, and there's nowhere in that room to turn them.
[trait:Kind] If my room were bigger, I could take in someone who's sick. The barracks is no place to be sick.

blunt.li: I've dug bigger graves. Knock out a wall.
[trait:Recluse] I spend all my free time in there. Make it big enough to actually live in.
[old] I'm too old to climb over furniture to reach my own bed. Move a wall.

cheerful.li: Fun fact: I can touch both walls at once! Less fun fact: I don't want to!
[child] My room is so small my toys have to take turns!
If my room were bigger, I could have guests! Two guests! At the same time!

gloomy.li: Sleeping in a box. Practice for later, I suppose.
[lowmood] There's no room to pace in there. And I really need to pace.
[night] In the dark I can hear my own breathing bounce off the walls. That's how close they are.

cold.li: I'm being stored in that room like spare parts. Allocate more space.
A cramped room means I rest poorly. Moving one wall is cheaper than my mistakes.

plain.li: I walked across my room. Across it! It took several steps.
[old] I can get out of bed without a fight now. Thank you.

warm.li: There's room for a visitor now. You'll have to come and sit with me.
[trait:Kind] I had two friends over at once. Nobody had to stand in the hall.

blunt.li: I can stretch without hitting anything. Took you long enough.

cheerful.li: I lay on the floor and made a snow angel. With no snow. Because I could!

gloomy.li: More room for my thoughts to rattle around in. Still. It's nicer.

cold.li: Better. My rest should improve. So should my work.

plain.li: I'll keep getting dressed sideways, then.
[promised] A bigger room, I was told. The walls haven't moved an inch.
[old] My knees will just have to keep complaining, then.

warm.li: It's cozy, I suppose. Cozy is a kind word for small.
[trusting] Maybe next season. I don't mind waiting. Much.

blunt.li: When I put my fist through the wall, that one's on you.

cheerful.li: Small room, small cleaning! Silver linings!

gloomy.li: [lowmood] It's fine. I don't take up much room these days anyway.

cold.li: Unfortunate. Small rooms make me irritable, and irritable people make mistakes. We'll see which ones.

plain.li: Hit my head on the wall getting up again. About the room.

warm.li: Whenever someone has a spare afternoon, my room could still use another few feet.

blunt.li: My room hasn't grown. I checked with my forehead.

gloomy.li: [night] Lying in the dark, I can feel the walls. Still too close.

cold.li: [repeat] I have asked for {WISH} more than once. This is me asking again, calmly.

cheerful.li: Still bumping into everything! I've started naming the bruises!

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} sneaks over in the middle of the night anyway. We might as well make it official with {THING}.
[storm] Thunder all night, and {OTHER_nameDef} was on the other side of the colony. I'd like {THING}.
[old] {OTHER_nameDef} and I have been together a long time. Long enough to have earned one bed.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has nightmares sometimes. I'd like to be close enough to wake {OTHER_objective} gently.
[hurt] I'm healing slowly. I'd heal faster with {OTHER_nameDef} beside me.
[winter] {OTHER_nameDef}'s hands are always cold at night. I'd like to be the one warming them.

blunt.li: Two beds for one couple. Who planned that? Fix it.
[trait:Jealous] I don't like {OTHER_nameDef} sleeping where anyone can wander past. One bed. Ours.
[repeat] {OTHER_nameDef} and I are still sleeping apart. Asking again. Fix it.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} steals blankets. I've decided I want that to be my problem every night!
[spring] It's spring! Everything's pairing up! Even the muffalo! {OTHER_nameDef} and I would like {THING}!
[night] {OTHER_nameDef} and I keep whispering goodnight down the hall! Everyone's complaining! Give us {THING}!

gloomy.li: Any night could be the last one on this rock. I'd rather spend them next to {OTHER_nameDef}.
[lowmood] Some nights the only thing that would help is {OTHER_nameDef}'s hand, and it's across the room.

cold.li: I sleep better when I know exactly where {OTHER_nameDef} is. One bed would settle that.
[trait:Psychopath] Pair bonds keep a colony stable. Ours would be more stable in a shared bed. It's logical.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} snores. I never knew. I don't mind at all.
[winter] Cold feet against my legs all night. Best thing that's happened all winter.
[promised] {OTHER_nameDef} didn't think you'd keep your word. I did. We're both glad I was right.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} fell asleep holding my hand. I didn't move for an hour. Thank you.

blunt.li: [morning] We were late to work. You'll live.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} hogs the blankets and I've never been happier!
[morning] {OTHER_nameDef} woke me with cold feet and I laughed instead of screaming! Progress!

gloomy.li: Whatever happens out there, I get to come back to {OTHER_nameDef}. That's more than most get.

cold.li: Better. I know where {OTHER_nameDef} is at night now. That matters to me.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I will push two beds together, then. It isn't the same.
[promised] We were told we'd get a bed together. {OTHER_nameDef} keeps asking me when.
[winter] We'll sleep in our coats and think of each other, I suppose.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} says it doesn't matter. I can tell that it does.

blunt.li: Great. Back to sneaking across the colony in the dark like teenagers.
[trait:Jealous] So {OTHER_nameDef} sleeps alone, where anyone can wander in for a chat. Great.

cheerful.li: Late-night visits it is! Very romantic. Very cold floor.

gloomy.li: [night] Somewhere in this colony, {OTHER_nameDef} is awake too. Not next to me. Never next to me.

cold.li: Disappointing. I won't bring personal matters to the council again.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I are still in separate beds. We keep hoping.

warm.li: [night] {OTHER_nameDef} asked me tonight whether the council had said anything about our bed. I didn't know what to say.

blunt.li: Still two beds. Still one couple. It isn't hard arithmetic.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I have already picked a side each! We just need the bed!

gloomy.li: [winter] Another cold night in separate beds. Winter's long enough as it is.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I are still assigned separate beds. I'd like that corrected.

plain.li: My spare shirt lives in a corner and my knife lives under the pillow. They'd both prefer {THING}.
[night] I knocked my water over reaching for it in the dark. Again. Somewhere to put it would help.
[newcomer] I'm still living out of my pack. Having {THING} would make it feel like I'm staying.

warm.li: I have a few keepsakes from before I came here. I'd love somewhere safe to keep them.
[old] Bending to the floor for my things gets harder every season. Could I have {THING}?
[trusting] I know there are bigger things to build. When there's a moment, {THING} would make my room feel finished.

blunt.li: I'm tired of digging through a pile for my socks. Build {THING}.
[trait:Greedy] I own things. Things need furniture. Give me {THING}.
[repeat] My things are still on the floor. I'm still asking. Build {THING}.

cheerful.li: If I had {THING}, I could put a rock on it! A nice rock! I've already found the rock!
[child] I need {THING} for my collection. It's bugs. Dead ones. Mostly.
[trait:Greedy] I have SO many things! Okay, six things! They all need {THING}!

gloomy.li: It's a bedroom with nothing in it but a bed. Feels like a cell.
[lowmood] Everything I own fits in one pile on the floor. Says a lot, doesn't it.
[grieving] I have a few things that belonged to someone I lost. They shouldn't have to live on the floor.

cold.li: Organized possessions mean less time wasted. Supply {THING}.
[trait:Psychopath] Someone has been touching my things. With {THING}, I'll know exactly when it happens again.

plain.li: I put my things away. All of them. It took four minutes.
[newcomer] I unpacked. First time since I got here.
[promised] It's exactly where I said it should go. Thank you for keeping your word.

warm.li: My keepsakes have a home now. It's silly how much that matters.
[grieving] I put their things on it. It looks like a little shrine. It helps.

blunt.li: Nobody touches my stuff now. Nobody.

cheerful.li: I've arranged and rearranged everything on it six times!

gloomy.li: It's just furniture. I didn't expect to feel this much about furniture.

cold.li: Order restored. My things are where I left them, and I'll know if they aren't.

plain.li: My things will stay in the corner, then. They've gotten used to it.
[promised] I cleared a spot for {THING}. The spot's still clear.

warm.li: An old crate does the job, mostly. Don't worry about me.
[grieving] The keepsakes will stay in my pack, then. Safe enough.

blunt.li: Anyone who steps on my stuff can take it up with you, then.
[bitter] Can't get one piece of furniture out of this council. Unbelievable.

cheerful.li: Floor storage! Very modern. Very... underfoot.

gloomy.li: Nothing in my room but me and a bed. Suits the mood around here.

cold.li: Not built. My room stays disorganized. So, I suspect, will I.

plain.li: Still stepping over my own things every morning. About {THING}...

warm.li: [trusting] I know you haven't forgotten {THING}. I'm just still hoping.

blunt.li: Tripped over my pack again. You know what fixes that.

gloomy.li: [night] Fumbled for my things in the dark again. The pile wins.

cheerful.li: My rock still has nowhere to sit! It's very patient! I'm less patient!

plain.li: I got dressed in the dark this morning. Shirt on backwards. Nobody told me until noon.
[trigger:dark] I walked into my own door last night. My own door. Some light would help.
[trait:Undergrounder] I don't mind the dark. I mind not seeing what's in it. A light, please.

warm.li: I'd like to mend clothes at night, or just see the face of whoever stops by. Could I have {THING}?
[child] It's really dark in my room. I'm not scared. It's just dark. Could I have a light? In case.
[old] My eyes aren't what they were. In the dark I'm practically blind. Could I have {THING}?

blunt.li: [trigger:dark] Can't see my hand in front of my face in there. Fix it before I break my neck.
Something in my room bit me last night. Might've been the bed frame. Might not. I'd like to see.
[repeat] I asked about a light already. I'm still feeling my way around like a mole.

cheerful.li: Light! In my room! I could do shadow puppets! I've been practicing a muffalo!
[winter] It's dark by suppertime! Give me {THING} and I'll make it so cozy in there!

gloomy.li: In the dark I start hearing things. Scratching. Probably just rats. Probably.
[lowmood] Lying in the dark with my own thoughts is the worst company I've ever kept.

cold.li: I can't see who comes into my room at night. I'd prefer to.
[trigger:dark] Injuries in the dark will cost us more than {THING} would. Build it.
[trait:Psychopath] I like to watch the door while I fall asleep. I can't watch what I can't see.

plain.li: I can find my boots now. Both of them. On the same morning.
[winter] Long dark evenings, and now a little light to spend them in.
[promised] A light, as promised. I believe you a little more now.

warm.li: It's such a soft light. I stayed up mending until late. Thank you.
[child] I'm not scared anymore. I wasn't scared before. But I'm extra not scared now.

blunt.li: Good. Now I can see who's knocking.

cheerful.li: [night] Shadow puppet show in my room tonight! Everyone's invited! Bring snacks!

gloomy.li: The dark's still out there. It just stays on the other side of the door now.

cold.li: Visibility restored. I'll know who comes in now.

plain.li: I've memorized where everything is. Mostly. My shins are keeping score.
[promised] I'm still waiting for that light. In the dark. Where I can't even see it not arriving.
[trigger:dark] I'll leave the door open and borrow whatever light drifts in. Not much does.

warm.li: It's alright. The dark isn't so bad once you stop looking at it.

blunt.li: Whatever. If I break my neck in there, put "should've had a light" on the grave.
[bitter] You can't even spare me a light. That says everything.

cheerful.li: No light? I'll just hum loudly. Monsters hate humming. Probably!

gloomy.li: [night] Dark again. Of course it's dark. It was always going to be dark.

cold.li: Very well. I'll navigate by memory. Nobody move anything in my room.

plain.li: [night] Banged my knee on the bed frame again. That light, whenever you're ready.

warm.li: I don't like to fuss, but my room is still awfully dark at night.

blunt.li: [trigger:dark] Still dark in my room. I walked into the doorframe this morning. Hard.

cheerful.li: My room's still a cave! I've started greeting the darkness by name!

gloomy.li: [lowmood] I've stopped expecting the light. I haven't stopped wanting it.

cold.li: My room remains unlit. I've begun to hear things in it that I can't account for.

plain.li: I get maybe two hours of real sleep a night in that room. A little {SUBJECT} would change that.
[trigger:cold] I slept curled up so tight I couldn't straighten my back this morning.
[trigger:heat] I've started sleeping on the floor because it's the coolest thing in the room. It isn't cool.
[repeat] Still waking up wrecked from that room. I'm asking again for {SUBJECT}.

warm.li: [trigger:cold] I lent my blanket to someone colder, and now I'm the colder one. Could my room get {THING}?
[trigger:heat] I don't want to complain when others have it worse. But I haven't really slept in two days.
[old,trigger:heat] At my age the heat sits on your chest all night. A little cool air would be a mercy.

blunt.li: [trigger:cold] My breath freezes on the blanket. Put {THING} in there or I'm sleeping in the kitchen.
[trigger:heat] It's an oven in there. I'm not bread. Fix it.

cheerful.li: [trigger:cold] Experiment: how many shirts can one person sleep in? Answer: five. Better answer: {THING}!
[trigger:heat] I sweated enough last night to water a field! Could we get {THING} in my room?
[highmood] Somehow I'm cheerful on two hours of sleep! Think what I'd be like with {SUBJECT}!

gloomy.li: Every night I lie there waiting for morning like it's a rescue party.
[trigger:cold] Woke up blue around the lips. One of these nights I won't wake up.

cold.li: Keep me sleeping like this and I'll make a mistake eventually. In surgery, maybe. Or in a fight.
[trigger:heat] Heatstroke would cost you days of my work. Building {THING} costs less.

plain.li: [trigger:cold] I could hear {FOR_nameDef}'s teeth chattering through the wall. Could we get {THING} into {FOR_possessive} room?

warm.li: {FOR_nameDef} hasn't slept properly in days and won't say a word about it. A little {SUBJECT} in {FOR_possessive} room would help.

blunt.li: [trigger:heat] {FOR_nameDef} comes out of that room like a boiled potato every morning. Cool it down.

plain.li: I woke up rested. I didn't recognize the feeling at first.
[trigger:cold] I can feel my toes. All of them. I counted.
[forother] I hear {PAWN_nameDef} spoke up about my room. Tell {PAWN_objective} I finally slept.
[promised] You promised, and I slept. Both of those are rare out here.

warm.li: [trigger:heat] I didn't sweat through the sheets. I'm almost embarrassed by how happy that makes me.

blunt.li: [trigger:cold] Warm. Good. The kitchen is safe from me.

cheerful.li: I slept like a happy little boomrat!

gloomy.li: One less thing keeping me awake. There are others. But one less.

cold.li: Sleep restored. You'll see the difference in my work, I imagine.
[trigger:cold] Warm enough. I no longer need to borrow anyone else's bed.

plain.li: [trigger:cold] I'll go to bed holding a warm stone, like my grandmother did. It never worked for her either.
[trigger:heat] I'll sleep with a wet rag over my face, then.
[promised] I was promised {SUBJECT}. I got another night exactly like the last one.

warm.li: It can't stay like this forever. The seasons change, at least. I'll hold on until they do.
[forother] I'm sorry, {FOR_nameDef}. I tried. You can have my blanket.

blunt.li: [forother] I asked for {FOR_nameDef}, not for me. And you still couldn't be bothered.

cheerful.li: Extreme sleeping! It builds character!

gloomy.li: [trigger:cold] One of these nights the cold wins. I'd like it on record that I asked.

cold.li: Then I'll sleep somewhere else. Somewhere with {SUBJECT}. Whoever's bed that is.

plain.li: Another night like the last one. My room still needs {SUBJECT}.
[trigger:cold] Frost on the inside of the wall this morning. Any news on {THING}?

warm.li: [forother] {FOR_nameDef} still isn't sleeping. I haven't forgotten, even if the council has.

blunt.li: [trigger:heat] Still cooking in there. Any day now.

gloomy.li: I've been counting the bad nights. You don't want to know the number.

cheerful.li: [trigger:cold] Still sleeping in five shirts! I'm up to six now! Send help! Or {THING}!

plain.li: I had to hold my bowl in one hand and fend off a squirrel with the other. A table, please.
[trigger:floor] I ate standing up by the stockpile, between a crate and a dead boomrat.
[afterraid] We just fought for our lives. I'd like to eat sitting down.
[repeat] I'm asking about the table again because I'm still eating off my lap.

warm.li: Meals are when we actually talk to each other. It's hard to talk while crouched in the dirt.
[child] Can we have a table? So everyone eats together? I want to sit next to someone.
[evening] I'd love one evening where everyone sits down at the same time and nobody eats over a stockpile.

blunt.li: [trigger:floor] I've eaten off cleaner rocks in a raider camp. Build a table.
My back's bent from eating hunched over a crate. Get {THING} built before it sets that way.
[trait:Ugly] People already don't like looking at me. Watching me eat off the floor isn't helping.

cheerful.li: A table means table manners! I've been practicing mine on the floor!
[winter] Imagine a hot meal at a table on a cold night! Elbows touching! Steam everywhere!

gloomy.li: We eat like scavengers. Hunched, quick, looking over our shoulders.
[lowmood] I don't even taste the food anymore. Maybe sitting down to it would help.

cold.li: [trigger:floor] Eating on the floor makes people sullen. Sullen people fight. A table is cheaper than a fight.
Spilled food draws vermin, and vermin draw disease. Build {THING} somewhere with walls.
[trait:Psychopath] People who eat together trust each other more. I'd like them to trust me more. Build a table.

plain.li: I spilled my soup and it went on the table. Not on my boots. Progress.
[petition] Everyone who asked for this table is sitting at it. Look at that.
[promised] A table, just like you said. I'm sitting at it right now.

warm.li: Someone passed me the bread without my asking. Little things. That's what a table is for.

blunt.li: Chair, table, food. I can finally eat without my knees in my soup.

cheerful.li: [evening] First proper supper at our table! I made a speech! Nobody asked me to!

gloomy.li: We sat together and nobody talked about the dead for a whole meal. That's something.

cold.li: Meals are shorter and tidier now. Good.

plain.li: Back to squatting by the stockpile, then. Mind the squirrels.
[promised] We were meant to have a table by now. I'm eating off a crate lid.
[rain] Eating in the rain again. The soup gets thinner with every bite.

warm.li: We'll sit in a circle on the ground, then. It's almost the same. Almost.
[child] That's okay. I'll sit on the floor next to someone. That's almost a table.

blunt.li: [trigger:floor] Don't complain when I start eating in your bed.

cheerful.li: Picnic every day! Forever! ...Picnics are fun. Mostly.

gloomy.li: Eating in the dirt. We'll be buried in it soon enough. Might as well get used to it.

cold.li: Morale costs will follow. I won't say I warned you. I'll just think it.

plain.li: [trigger:floor] Ate on the floor again today. Still thinking about {WISH}.

warm.li: [evening] It would be lovely to have supper together at a real table. Whenever there's time.

blunt.li: [petition] Half the colony asked for a table. Half the colony is still eating off its knees.

cheerful.li: Still no table! I've been setting the floor very nicely, though!

gloomy.li: We still eat crouched in corners, like we're hiding from something. Maybe we are.

cold.li: Meals are still eaten off the floor. I've counted the arguments this causes.

plain.li: I've beaten myself at every game we own. I've also lost to myself. Could we get {THING}?
[trigger:cabin] I caught myself watching a stone wall yesterday. For an hour. It didn't do anything.
[rain] It's been raining for days. There's nothing to do inside but listen to it.
[child] Everyone says "go play." Play WHAT? With WHAT?

warm.li: Something we could all do together in the evenings would be good for us. Maybe {THING}?
[lowmood] If we had something new to do, I think people would stop snapping at each other. Me included.
[old] I'd love something gentle to do in the evenings. My hands aren't up to much, but my mind is.

blunt.li: I'm so bored I volunteered to clean. Volunteered. Build {THING}.
[trait:Abrasive] Give me something to do or I'll start picking fights for fun. Nobody wants that.
[repeat] Still bored. Still asking. Build {THING} before I build something worse.

cheerful.li: I invented a game where you throw pebbles at a bucket. I'm the champion. Also the only player. Let's get {THING}!
[highmood] I'm in the mood for something new! Anything! How about {THING}?

gloomy.li: Same walls, same three games, same people losing at them. Including me.
[winter] Months of winter and nothing to fill them. The quiet is getting into people.
[trigger:cabin] I've been inside so long I've started to hate the sound of my own chewing.

cold.li: [trigger:cabin] Cabin fever comes before a breakdown. I'd rather not find out what mine looks like. So would you.
Bored people talk. Bored people talk about me. Give them {THING} to keep them busy.

plain.li: I played until my eyes hurt. Then I played a bit more.
[trigger:cabin] Something new to do. I didn't realize how close I was to cracking.
[promised] You promised, you delivered, and I've already lost three games. Fair trade.

warm.li: Everyone was laughing tonight. Even the ones who never laugh. Thank you.

blunt.li: [trait:Abrasive] Fine. It's fun. Don't make a big thing of it.

cheerful.li: [evening] I've challenged everyone to a tournament! Losers wash dishes! I'm going to wash so many dishes!

gloomy.li: For an hour I forgot to be miserable. That's rare.

cold.li: The colony is calmer already. Recreation is an underrated control measure.

plain.li: Back to the pebbles and the bucket, then.
[promised] Something new to do, I was promised. I spent the whole time waiting for it. Very fun.

warm.li: We'll make our own fun, then. Stories cost nothing, and we've got plenty of those.
[child] Will somebody play with me instead, then? Just for a bit?

blunt.li: Great. Back to throwing rocks at the boomalope and hoping it doesn't explode. Or hoping it does.
[trigger:cabin] When I crack, try to look surprised.

cheerful.li: No problem! I've started a rock collection! It's one rock. Its name is Pebble.

gloomy.li: [lowmood] I'll just sit, then. I'm getting very good at sitting.

cold.li: Then expect someone to snap within the month. It won't be me. Probably.

plain.li: [trigger:cabin] Still nothing new to do. I've started arguing with the furniture.
[winter] It's still winter, and there's still nothing to do. About {WISH}...

warm.li: [petition] A lot of us are hoping for {WISH}. Just so the council knows it isn't only me.

blunt.li: Still bored. Dangerously bored. Consider yourself warned.

cheerful.li: My pebble game has rules now! Seventeen of them! Please build {THING} before I add more!

gloomy.li: [night] Another evening of staring at the wall. The wall is winning.

plain.li: I'd water it every morning before work. It would be the best-kept plant on the rim.
[skill:Plants] I spend all day in the fields and come home to bare stone. I'd like to bring a little of the fields inside.
[rain] The rain makes everything outside grow, and my room stays gray. One green thing, please.
[repeat] My room is still the grayest place I go all day. Have you thought any more about the plant?

warm.li: A little plant by the bed would make the mornings gentler. I'd take good care of it.
[old] I've grown things my whole life. I'd like something growing beside me now.
[grieving] Someone I lost loved flowers. I'd like to keep one growing, for them.

blunt.li: This colony lets people wear hats made of human leather. I'm asking for a flower.
[trait:Abrasive] Get me {THING}. Plants don't talk back. I want more things that don't talk back.
[snow] My fields are buried in snow and I've got nothing to tend. Get me {THING}, quick.

cheerful.li: I'll talk to it every morning! Plants love that! Probably! It's polite, at least!
[spring] Everything's sprouting! Let me sprout something in my room too!

gloomy.li: Something green to look at when everything else has gone gray. That's not too much, is it.
[lowmood] At least a plant wouldn't leave. Or die. Well. It might die.

cold.li: Tending something small keeps me calm. You'd all prefer me calm.
[trait:Psychopath] I like watching things grow. I like deciding what gets pruned. A plant in my room, please.
[skill:Plants] I keep the fields alive for everyone. One plant for myself is a modest fee.

plain.li: I've watered it twice already. I know that's too much. I couldn't help it.
[morning] The first thing I saw this morning was something green. Good start.
[promised] It's planted, it's watered, and you kept your word. Three good things.

warm.li: I'll keep it alive. It's in good hands.

blunt.li: Good. Nobody touches it. Nobody waters it but me.

cheerful.li: I've introduced it to the room! The room loves it!
[spring] It's sprouting! Everyone come look! It's very small! Look harder!

gloomy.li: It's leaning toward the light. Hopeful little thing. Maybe I'll learn something from it.

cold.li: It's thriving. I've made sure of that.

plain.li: No plant. I'll keep some soil in a bowl and pretend.
[promised] I'd already picked out the seeds. Never mind.
[skill:Plants] I'll spend more time in the fields, then. At least those plants are mine to look after.

warm.li: I'll press a few flowers between two stones and keep those instead. It's almost the same.

blunt.li: I'll dig one up from the field myself. Don't tell anyone.

cheerful.li: I'll draw a plant on the wall! It's a very good plant! It's mostly a circle!

gloomy.li: Of course. Nothing grows in here. Not even me.

cold.li: Disappointing. I had the spot measured.

plain.li: [skill:Plants] I keep tracking soil into my room anyway. Might as well be in a pot.

warm.li: Still hoping for a little green by my bed, whenever there's a moment.

cheerful.li: I've already named the plant I don't have yet! It's waiting for you!

gloomy.li: [winter] Everything outside is dead and my room is still bare. Just mentioning it.

blunt.li: Still no plant. I could have it growing in a day if someone built the pot.

plain.li: There's a hole in my shirt right over the heart, and I'm fairly sure it came with the shirt.
[trigger:naked] These pants have the last owner's name stitched inside. I'd rather not think about the last owner.
[trait:Beauty] Look at me. Now look at these rags. One of us doesn't belong.

warm.li: I patch these every night. The patches have patches now. Could the tailor spare a little cloth?
[child] My sleeves stop at my elbows now. I think I grew. Could I have something bigger?
[trait:Kind] I'd give these to someone who needs them more, but nobody needs rags.

blunt.li: [trigger:naked] I'm done wearing a corpse's pants. Clothes. Now.
My shirt has fewer threads than I have patience, and neither will last the week.
[repeat] Asked before. These rags have only gotten worse since. Clothes.

cheerful.li: I'd love something in a color that isn't "mud"! Any color! Surprise me!
[spring] New season, new clothes! I just made that saying up, but it's a good one!
[highmood] Today's too nice a day to spend in a dead raider's shirt!

gloomy.li: [lowmood] When your clothes are falling apart, it's hard to believe you aren't.
[winter] My coat lets in more wind than it keeps out. I'll lose a toe before spring.

cold.li: These clothes are bloodstained. People are uneasy around me as it is. Let's not help them.
[trigger:naked] My clothes belonged to someone I killed. Sentiment aside, they don't fit.

plain.li: [winter] {FOR_nameDef} is out in the snow in a shirt meant for summer. Could the tailor make {FOR_objective} something warm?

blunt.li: {FOR_nameDef} is still wearing that dead raider's jacket. It's grim. Make {FOR_objective} something.

cheerful.li: {FOR_nameDef} deserves something new and nice! Something with a hood! I'll pick the color!

plain.li: Clean cloth, no holes, no stains. I keep touching the sleeves.
[trigger:naked] I buried the old ones. They'd earned it.
[forother] {PAWN_nameDef} told the council about my rags? I'll thank {PAWN_objective} in person.
[promised] Brand new, like you promised. I'll try not to bleed on them.

warm.li: [child] It fits! And there's room to grow! Thank you!

blunt.li: Now I look like someone you'd trade with, not someone you'd shoot.

cheerful.li: [spring] New clothes for spring! I'm practically a flower!

gloomy.li: Whole clothes. Nobody died in them. A small mercy.

cold.li: Clean, and they fit. People will be less suspicious. Good.

plain.li: I'll keep wearing this, then. It's mostly holes, but they're my holes now.
[promised] The tailor was going to get to it, I was told. My elbows are out in the wind.
[winter] I'll wrap a blanket around myself and call it a coat.

warm.li: Someone else probably needed the cloth more. I hope it went to them.

blunt.li: [trigger:naked] Great. Dead raider chic it is. Hope nobody recognizes the jacket.

cheerful.li: Rags are just clothes with extra air holes! Very breathable!

gloomy.li: [forother] I asked for {FOR_nameDef}, not for me. And {FOR_nameDef} is still in rags. Nobody listens.

cold.li: Then I'll take clothes off the next raider I kill. It's faster than waiting for you.

plain.li: Same old rags today. Any word on {WISH}?
[trigger:naked] Still in a dead raider's shirt. Some days it feels like the raider is wearing me.

warm.li: [forother] {FOR_nameDef} still hasn't got anything new to wear. I keep thinking about it.

blunt.li: [winter] My shirt's got a new hole. The snow comes in through it. Clothes. Today.

cheerful.li: My shirt lost another button today! It's getting very fashionable!

gloomy.li: [lowmood] These rags again today. I'm starting to look the way I feel.

plain.li: The animals found {OTHER_nameDef} last night. I chased them off. I can't keep chasing them off.
[trigger:death] I can still hear {OTHER_nameDef}'s voice. I can't stand to look at the body. Let's bury {OTHER_objective}.
[summer] It's hot. You know what the heat does. Please, for {OTHER_nameDef}'s sake.
[grieving] I keep setting a place for {OTHER_nameDef} at supper. Help me lay {OTHER_objective} to rest, at least.
[repeat] {OTHER_nameDef} is still out there. Nothing has changed since I asked, except the smell.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} would have done it for any of us. Let's do this one thing for {OTHER_objective}.
[child] Is {OTHER_nameDef} going to stay out there? Somebody should tuck {OTHER_objective} in. In the ground, I mean.
[trait:Kind] {OTHER_nameDef} was kind to me when nobody else was. The least I can do is see {OTHER_objective} properly buried.

blunt.li: [trigger:death] We don't leave our own lying in the mud. Not here. Bury {OTHER_nameDef}.
I'll dig the hole myself if nobody else will. Just somebody tell me where.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} would hate all this attention. Let's give {OTHER_objective} a quiet spot with a nice view.
[spring] {OTHER_nameDef} loved the spring. Let's bury {OTHER_objective} somewhere the flowers come up.
I've been telling everyone {OTHER_nameDef}'s funniest stories. Let's put {OTHER_objective} somewhere we can visit and tell more.

gloomy.li: Every day {OTHER_nameDef} lies out there, it gets a little easier to imagine it's me.
[night] I dreamed {OTHER_nameDef} asked me why nobody came. I didn't have an answer.
[snow] The snow's covering {OTHER_nameDef}. It looks almost peaceful. It isn't.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} was useful. Useful people get graves. It encourages the others.
I didn't like {OTHER_nameDef} much. I still want {OTHER_objective} buried properly. Standards matter.

plain.li: I put a stone on the grave. I'll put another one there tomorrow.
[grieving] It still hurts. But now I know where to go when it does.
[petition] Everyone who asked was there at the end. {OTHER_nameDef} would have liked that.
[promised] {OTHER_nameDef} is in the ground, like you promised. That means more than I can say.

warm.li: I promised {OTHER_nameDef} we'd look after each other. We will.

blunt.li: Good. {OTHER_nameDef} deserved a hole of {OTHER_possessive} own. Now leave me alone for a while.

cheerful.li: I told a bad joke at the graveside. {OTHER_nameDef} would have groaned. That's how I know it was right.

gloomy.li: [night] I sat by the grave until dark. It was quieter in my head than it's been in days.

cold.li: Done properly. {OTHER_nameDef}'s belongings should be redistributed now. I've started a list.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is still out there. I've stopped walking that way.
[promised] I was promised {OTHER_nameDef} would be buried. I won't take a promise from this council again.
[night] I went and sat with {OTHER_nameDef} tonight, so {OTHER_nameDef} wasn't alone. Somebody had to.

warm.li: I covered {OTHER_nameDef} with a blanket. It's the best I could do. It isn't enough.

blunt.li: [trigger:death] I'll dig it myself tonight. Don't any of you try to stop me.

cheerful.li: I keep telling myself {OTHER_nameDef} wouldn't mind. {OTHER_nameDef} would mind.

gloomy.li: [grieving] So that's what we're worth here. Good to know before it's my turn.

cold.li: So bodies stay where they fall here. I'll make my own arrangements in advance.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is still lying out there. Every day. Please.
[trigger:death] I walked past {OTHER_nameDef} again this morning. I won't stop asking.

warm.li: [petition] We're all still waiting to say a proper goodbye to {OTHER_nameDef}.

blunt.li: [summer] It's getting hot. Bury {OTHER_nameDef} before the smell does the asking for me.

gloomy.li: [night] Couldn't sleep. Kept thinking of {OTHER_nameDef} out there under the open sky.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef}'s body is still out there. Every day it gets harder to handle. Practically speaking.

plain.li: I still feel my {SUBJECT} sometimes. It itches. It isn't there. Could the doctor fit me with {THING}?
[trigger:injury] The stitches are out. My {SUBJECT} is still gone. I'd like {THING}.
[skill:Crafting] I'd help make it myself, if someone shows me how. I want my {SUBJECT} back, near enough.
[repeat] My {SUBJECT} hasn't grown back since the last time I asked. I checked.

warm.li: I hate watching the others pick up my slack. With {THING}, they wouldn't have to.
[trusting] I know it's a lot to ask. I'd just like to be all of me again, or close to it.
[skill:Medicine] I've treated enough wounds to know what a good fit could do for me. Please consider {THING}.

blunt.li: [trigger:injury] Something out there walked off with my {SUBJECT}. I want a replacement before I go and get it back.
I'm not a charity case. Fit me with {THING} and I'll prove it.

cheerful.li: Think of the stories! "Oh, this old thing? Lost the real one to a squirrel." Please let me have {THING}!
[spacer] I've heard the new parts can be better than the old ones! Sign me up!
[highmood] Today I feel unstoppable! Mostly! A full set of parts would cover the rest!

gloomy.li: People look at the gap first, and at me second. I'd like it the other way round again.
[lowmood] Some mornings I forget. Then I try to get up, and I remember.

cold.li: I've lost part of my body. I'd rather not lose part of my usefulness too. Install {THING}.
[trait:Psychopath] The part they took was mine. The replacement doesn't need to be. Any donor will do.

warm.li: {FOR_nameDef} keeps insisting it's fine. I've seen {FOR_objective} struggle when nobody's looking. Could we get {THING} for {FOR_objective}?

blunt.li: {FOR_nameDef} has been without a {SUBJECT} long enough. The least we owe {FOR_objective} is a replacement.

cold.li: {FOR_nameDef} works at half capacity. Fitting {THING} fixes that. It's simple.

plain.li: I keep forgetting it isn't mine. That's a good sign, isn't it?
[forother] I heard {PAWN_nameDef} pushed for this. I'll make sure {PAWN_nameDef} knows it worked.
[promised] Close enough to whole. You said you'd see to it, and you did.

warm.li: I did a whole day's work without anyone's help. Thank you. You don't know what that means.

blunt.li: [trigger:injury] Good as new. Better, maybe. Next time it'll be them missing a piece.

cheerful.li: I've shown it to everyone! Twice! Some people three times!

gloomy.li: It's strange. Part of me is a thing now. I'll get used to it.

cold.li: Integrated. I'm whole enough to be useful again.

plain.li: I'll keep working around it. I'm getting good at working around things.
[promised] I've waited for {THING} the way I used to wait for my {SUBJECT} to grow back.
[forother] {FOR_nameDef} is still managing without. I'm sorry I couldn't do more.

warm.li: The doctor has a lot of people to look after. I'll try not to be one of them.

blunt.li: [forother] {FOR_nameDef} is still missing a {SUBJECT}, and this council is still missing a spine.

cheerful.li: Fewer parts, fewer things to break, right? Right?

gloomy.li: So this is how I'll be from now on. Alright. Alright.

cold.li: Then I'll be less useful. Don't act surprised when it shows.

plain.li: [trigger:injury] Still missing my {SUBJECT}. Still hoping someone's working on {THING}.

warm.li: [forother] {FOR_nameDef} hasn't complained once. That's exactly why I keep bringing it up.

blunt.li: Tried to do my job today without my {SUBJECT}. Went about how you'd think.

gloomy.li: [lowmood] I'd stopped expecting {THING}. Then I saw the doctor and started hoping again. Please don't make me stop.

cheerful.li: Still rehearsing my dramatic reveal for {THING}! It's getting really good!

plain.li: I've been leaving scraps out for that {SUBJECT}. It came closer yesterday. Let me try.
[skill:Animals] I know that look. That {SUBJECT} is halfway to tame already. Give me a day.
[morning] I watched that {SUBJECT} at sunrise. I'd like to watch it every sunrise.
[repeat] That {SUBJECT} is still hanging around. So am I. So is my question.

warm.li: Out here everything is either hunting us or being hunted. That {SUBJECT} could be neither. Just ours.
[old] I always had an animal at my feet, before. I'd like one again while I still can.
[grieving] I need something to look after right now. Something that won't die on me. That {SUBJECT}, maybe.

blunt.li: There's a {SUBJECT} out there and I want it. I'll do the work. Just say yes.
[trait:Abrasive] I get along with animals better than with any of you. Let me prove it with that {SUBJECT}.
[winter] That {SUBJECT} is freezing out there. So bring it in. What's the problem?

cheerful.li: That {SUBJECT} looked right at me! It's fate! Let me tame it!
[child] There's a {SUBJECT} outside! I saw it first, so it's mine! Can it be mine?

gloomy.li: Something warm that doesn't know what this place is. I could use that.
[lowmood] Something worse will eat that {SUBJECT} soon. Let's get to it first. The nice way.

cold.li: A tame {SUBJECT} is labor, warmth or food, depending on the season. I'm flexible.
[trait:Psychopath] Animals are honest about what they want. I find that restful. Let me tame the {SUBJECT}.
[skill:Animals] I've studied that {SUBJECT} for days. I know what it wants. Let me give it that, and keep it.

plain.li: It followed me all the way to the kitchen and back. I think we're friends now.
[night] It's asleep at the foot of my bed. I'm not moving until morning.
[promised] You said I could try, and it worked. Look at it. Just look at it.

warm.li: I'll look after it like it was always ours. Thank you for letting me.

blunt.li: Good. Anyone who kicks it answers to me.

cheerful.li: It licked my face! It also bit me a little! Best day!

gloomy.li: It doesn't know about raids or graves. It just wants food and a scratch. Lucky thing.

cold.li: Tame and responsive. It learns faster than some colonists I could name.

plain.li: It wandered off. I watched it go. That's that.
[promised] By the time anyone said yes, it was long gone.
[winter] It's out in the cold somewhere. I hope it's alright.

warm.li: I hope it finds somewhere safe. Somewhere without us, maybe.

blunt.li: Something's probably eaten it by now. Hope you're happy.

cheerful.li: There's always another one! Out there! Somewhere!

gloomy.li: [lowmood] Even the animals don't stay. Figures.

cold.li: The opportunity has passed. Some hunter will get the meat. Wasteful.

plain.li: That {SUBJECT} is still out there. I saw it near the edge of the fields this morning.

warm.li: [skill:Animals] The {SUBJECT} took food from my hand yesterday. Please let me finish what I started.

blunt.li: That {SUBJECT} won't wait forever. Yes or no?

cheerful.li: I still think about that {SUBJECT}! I've named it three times now!

gloomy.li: [lowmood] I watch for the {SUBJECT} every morning. It's the only thing I look forward to.

plain.li: [trigger:raid] I'd like the next lot of raiders to meet {SUBJECT} before they meet us.
[trigger:raid] I keep seeing the spot where they broke through. Put {SUBJECT} there. Please.
[child] When the bad people come, I hide under the bed. Can we build {SUBJECT} so I don't have to?
[repeat] The raiders keep coming back. So will I, until we have more {SUBJECT}.

warm.li: [trigger:raid] I stitched up more friends today than I ever want to again. More {SUBJECT}, please.
I don't care about the walls for my sake. I care about who's behind them.
I'd like the next raid to end before it reaches anyone I care about. More {SUBJECT}, please.

blunt.li: [trigger:raid] They almost got in. Almost. Next time almost won't cut it. Build {SUBJECT}.
[skill:Shooting] I can hit anything I can see. I'd like something to hide behind while I see it.

cheerful.li: I've drawn up a plan for {SUBJECT}! It's mostly arrows pointing at where the raiders lose!
[trait:Pyromaniac] What if the defenses were on fire? No? Okay, okay. More {SUBJECT}, then. But consider fire.
[trigger:raid] We won! Barely! I'd like to win by more next time! Let's build {SUBJECT}!

gloomy.li: Every raid, a few fewer of us. The arithmetic isn't on our side without more {SUBJECT}.
[night] I sleep with my boots on now. In case. I'd like to take them off again someday.

cold.li: [trigger:raid] Today cost us blood. More {SUBJECT} would have cost us only materials. Build them.
I'd like the raiders to die further from my bed. Build more {SUBJECT}.

plain.li: I walked the perimeter today and didn't feel sick. That's new.
[petition] We asked for it together. Now we hold it together.
[promised] You promised we'd be ready. I think we are. I hope we are.

warm.li: I slept the whole night. I think I can stop flinching at every sound.

blunt.li: [trait:Bloodlust] Good. Now they'll die in a nice neat row.

cheerful.li: [night] Goodnight, raiders! Come by anytime! Please don't!

gloomy.li: It won't stop them. It'll slow them. Slower is good. Slower is time.

cold.li: Kill zones established. I sleep better knowing exactly where they'll die.

plain.li: [promised] We were going to be ready. Let's hope the raiders are running late too.
I've started sleeping with something heavy by the bed. Not that it'll help.

warm.li: I'll keep watch myself, then. Someone has to.

blunt.li: [trigger:raid] Next time they come, I'm pointing them at the council's rooms.
[bitter] Great. We'll greet the next raid with harsh language.

cheerful.li: Plan B: we all shout really loudly. It might work! It won't work.

gloomy.li: [night] I'll lie awake listening for them, then. I was going to anyway.

cold.li: Losses next raid will be higher than necessary. I'll be keeping track of whose.

plain.li: [trigger:raid] The blood's barely dry and nothing's changed. More {SUBJECT}, please.
[night] Heard something out past the fields tonight. Probably nothing. Still waiting on {WISH}.

warm.li: [petition] All of us who asked for {WISH} are still asking. We'd just like to see each other next season.

blunt.li: They'll come back. You know it. I know it. Build {SUBJECT}.

cold.li: Every day without more {SUBJECT}, the next raid gets cheaper for them.

gloomy.li: [afterraid] They came again. We still haven't built {SUBJECT}.

plain.li: When the Empire's envoys come, they'll see my {SUBJECT} first. I'd rather they didn't laugh.
[trait:Greedy] A title without the trappings is just a word. I want the trappings.
[newcomer] I know I've only just arrived. I also know what my rank requires, and the {SUBJECT} isn't it.
[repeat] I've mentioned my {SUBJECT} before. Respectfully. I'm mentioning it again, slightly less so.

warm.li: It isn't vanity, I promise. The Empire notices these things, and I'd hate for it to cost all of you.
[trusting] You've been patient with my title. I'll ask for one more patience: my {SUBJECT}, please.
[highmood] I'm in good spirits, truly. A {SUBJECT} fit for the title would keep me there.

blunt.li: I didn't earn this title to live like a peasant. My {SUBJECT}. Fix it.
[bitter] The Empire gave me a title. This council gave me a hovel. Interesting choice.
[trait:Abrasive] I've seen stables with better furnishings than my {SUBJECT}. Fix it.

cheerful.li: Picture me in my {SUBJECT}, all gold and fine cloth, waving at everyone! You can wave back!
[highmood] Today I feel very noble! My {SUBJECT} should too!

gloomy.li: Every day spent below my station, I can feel the title rusting.
[lowmood] A noble in a shack. Someone will write a sad song about me. Badly.
[night] I dream about the halls I grew up in. Then I wake up here.

cold.li: My rank is a resource for this colony. Neglect it and it stops being useful to you.
[trait:Psychopath] The Empire values appearances. I value the Empire's favor. You'll fix my {SUBJECT}.

plain.li: It's worthy. I can receive anyone here now without blushing.
[morning] I woke up feeling like myself again. My titled self.
[promised] A noble remembers who keeps their word. I will remember this council.

warm.li: Thank you. I know it took real work. The Empire will hear of your kindness.

blunt.li: Good. Now it looks like a noble lives here, not a muffalo.

cheerful.li: I've spent all afternoon in it, being noble at people!

gloomy.li: It's grand. Somehow I still feel small in it. But it's grand.

cold.li: Standards met. My dignity is no longer a liability.

plain.li: [promised] A noble's word is binding. I see this council's isn't.
I may write to the Empire about the conditions here. Or I may not. We'll see.

warm.li: I understand. There are graver things than my comfort. I'll bear it.
[trusting] There were more pressing matters, I'm sure. I'll make my own apologies to the Empire.

blunt.li: When the Empire asks why I live in squalor, I'll be giving them names.

cheerful.li: Rustic! Nobles do rustic sometimes! I'll start a trend!

gloomy.li: The title is still mine. Everything that's meant to go with it, apparently, isn't.

cold.li: Noted. My cooperation will be calibrated to my circumstances.

plain.li: My {SUBJECT} is still not fit for my rank. I'd like that seen to, with respect.

blunt.li: Have you looked at my {SUBJECT}? Look at it. Then look at my title.

cheerful.li: I've been rehearsing how I'll greet guests in my new {SUBJECT}! I just need the new {SUBJECT}!

cold.li: [repeat] I have raised the matter of my {SUBJECT} before. I would prefer not to raise it a third time.

warm.li: I hate to keep mentioning my {SUBJECT}. The title, I'm afraid, won't let me stop.

plain.li: I asked a grown-up how reading works. Nobody had time to show me. Could we get {THING}?
[rain] It's raining, and every grown-up says "not now." With {THING}, I'd stop asking.
[afterraid] The loud bad people came again. I want something fun to think about instead.
[repeat] I asked before! You said maybe! Maybe is almost yes!

warm.li: If I had {THING}, I could learn stuff and help everyone more. Like a big person.
[grieving] I miss... someone. Maybe if I had {THING}, I'd think about it less.
[trait:Kind] If I had {THING}, I'd show everyone what I learned. Every single thing.

blunt.li: Grown-ups get workbenches and weapons. I get to sit in a corner. Not fair. I want {THING}.
[trait:Abrasive] I'm not going to be good until I get {THING}. That's the deal.
[afterraid] I helped carry stuff during the raid. That means I get {THING}. That's the rule.

cheerful.li: I'll draw you a picture every single day! I just need {THING}!
[snow] I made a snow person! It fell over! Now I need something to do inside, where my fingers work!
[highmood] I'm so happy today! I'd be EVEN happier with {THING}! That's how happy works!

gloomy.li: Everybody's too busy to play with me. Maybe {THING} wouldn't be.
[lowmood] I don't want to be in the way. If I had {THING}, I'd stay out of the way. Promise.

cold.li: If I learn more, I'll be useful sooner. Useful people don't get left behind.
[trait:Psychopath] I want {THING}. I'll be very quiet if I get it. I'm good at quiet.

plain.li: I've been here all day! I learned a word! I forgot it! I'll learn it again!
[evening] I don't want to go to bed. Can I stay a little longer? Just a little?
[promised] You said yes and you meant it! Grown-up promises CAN be good!

warm.li: Thank you! I'll take care of it! I'll even share! A bit!

blunt.li: Finally. Grown-ups CAN listen.

cheerful.li: This is the best day ever, and I've had at least six days!

gloomy.li: It's mine? Nobody's going to take it back? ...Okay.

cold.li: Good. I'll learn everything on it. Then I'll learn everything else.

plain.li: I'll play with rocks again. Rocks are fine. Rocks are always there.
[promised] You PROMISED. Grown-up promises are the worst kind.
[afterraid] Everyone was too busy with the raid. I know. I still wanted it.

warm.li: That's okay. I know everyone's busy keeping us alive.

blunt.li: Then I'm going to be bored at everyone. Loudly.

cheerful.li: I'll pretend the woodpile is a castle! It's a very lumpy castle!

gloomy.li: I knew it. Kids don't count here.

cold.li: I'll remember who said no. I remember everything.

plain.li: Is {THING} done yet? Is it done now? How about now?

warm.li: I've been really good. Really, really good. Just saying. About {THING}.

blunt.li: Hello? I asked for {THING} AGES ago.

gloomy.li: [lowmood] I don't think anyone's making {THING}. I'll stop asking. Maybe.

cheerful.li: I've counted to a hundred waiting for {THING}! Twice! Is it ready yet?

plain.li: I've been doing my best work standing up, in the rain, with half the tools. Imagine me with {SUBJECT}.
[trusting] You've backed me before. Back me on this one: {SUBJECT}. You won't regret it.
[newcomer] I didn't come all this way to do half a job. I'd like {SUBJECT}.
[repeat] Every day without {SUBJECT} is a day of half-work. I'll keep saying it.

warm.li: I'd teach anyone who wants to learn, if we had {SUBJECT}. It isn't just for me.
[old] I've got a few good working years left in me. I'd like to spend them in {SUBJECT}.
[trusting] I've never asked for much. I'm asking for {SUBJECT} because I think it'll make all our lives better.

blunt.li: Every time I get going, somebody walks through my work to reach the stockpile. I want {SUBJECT}.
[trait:Abrasive] I'm good at this, and I'm done pretending a dirt floor is fine. Build {SUBJECT}.
[afterraid] We nearly died today. If I'm going to die, I'd like to have done good work first. Build {SUBJECT}.

cheerful.li: I had a dream about {SUBJECT} and woke up grinning! Let's make it real!
[highmood] I feel like I could do anything today! With {SUBJECT}, I'd prove it!

gloomy.li: Some days the work is the only thing keeping me sane. Working like this, even that's slipping.
[lowmood] Give me {SUBJECT} and maybe I'll remember why I bothered learning any of this.
[winter] A long gray winter, and nowhere to do the only thing that helps. I need {SUBJECT}.

cold.li: You keep the best worker in the worst corner. I'd like {SUBJECT}, and I'd like it organized my way.
[trait:Psychopath] I don't love many things. I love this work. That should tell you how serious I am about {SUBJECT}.

plain.li: I spent the whole night in there. Don't tell anyone. Actually, tell everyone.
[petition] Everyone who backed this: come and see. You'll be the first to benefit.
[promised] I half thought you'd forget. You didn't. I'll make every stone of it worth it.

warm.li: Come by anytime. I mean it. I'll show you everything.

blunt.li: Good. Anything great I make in here, you'll know who to thank. Me. And you, a bit.

cheerful.li: [morning] Up before everyone! Best part of the day, in the best room in the colony!

gloomy.li: I made something today and I was proud of it. I'd forgotten that feeling.

cold.li: This will pay for itself within the season. Mark the date.

plain.li: [promised] I've been sketching {SUBJECT} in the dirt. The dirt's all I was given.
Back to working wherever there's room. Usually there isn't.

warm.li: It's alright. I'll teach someone what I know, in case I never get to do it properly.

blunt.li: Don't ask me for anything good, then. You haven't earned it.

cheerful.li: No matter! I've made my corner very cozy! The corner and I are friends now!

gloomy.li: [lowmood] I used to love this. I'm not sure I'll love it much longer.
[winter] Another winter of making do. I'm good at making do. I hate being good at it.

cold.li: Very well. Adequate work in an inadequate space. Don't mistake it for my best.

plain.li: Still waiting on {SUBJECT}. Every day I lose half an hour just finding my tools.

warm.li: [petition] A few of us are still hoping for {SUBJECT}. We'd all use it, I promise.

blunt.li: You know what I asked for. It isn't built. I'm still asking.

cheerful.li: I've added three more rooms to my plans for {SUBJECT}! We should probably build the first one, huh?

gloomy.li: [night] Lay awake planning {SUBJECT} again. It's nicer in my head than it'll ever be out here.

cold.li: I'm still producing a fraction of what I could. You're still paying for that.

plain.li: I watched someone do {SUBJECT} today. They were doing it wrong. I didn't say anything. Let me do it.
[trait:Industriousness] My hands don't know what to do with themselves when they're not doing {SUBJECT}.
[newcomer] Back home, {SUBJECT} was what I did. I'd like it to be what I do here too.
[repeat] Me again. Still about {SUBJECT}. Still more polite than I feel.

warm.li: Let me take some {SUBJECT} off someone else's hands. I'd enjoy it, and they'd get a rest.
[trusting] I trust your judgment on who does what. I'd just like a turn at {SUBJECT}.
[old] I've been doing {SUBJECT} longer than some of you have been alive. Let me keep my hand in.

blunt.li: I didn't survive this long to haul rocks all day. Let me do {SUBJECT}.
[bitter] Anyone in this colony can do {SUBJECT} except the one person who loves it. Me.
[afterraid] Today showed what happens when the wrong people do the wrong work. Put me on {SUBJECT}.

cheerful.li: I've been doing {SUBJECT} in my head all week! I'm amazing in my head!
[highmood] I'm in such a good mood I could do {SUBJECT} all day! Can I? Please?
[spring] New season! New start! New me, doing {SUBJECT}! Same me, really, but happier!

gloomy.li: Doing work I'm bad at all day, watching work I'm good at done badly. That's my life now.
[winter] A whole winter of hauling and cleaning. A little {SUBJECT} would keep me from going strange.

cold.li: You're using a scalpel to dig ditches. I'm the scalpel. Put me on {SUBJECT}.
[trait:Psychopath] I'm calmer when I'm doing {SUBJECT}. Everyone prefers me calm.

plain.li: I've been doing {SUBJECT} all day and I'm not even tired. Well. I'm tired. Good tired.
[morning] Woke up knowing what I'd be doing today. Best feeling there is.
[promised] Back on {SUBJECT}, just like you said. I didn't think you'd remember.

warm.li: Thank you for trusting me with it. I won't let anyone down.

blunt.li: About time. Watch and learn, everyone.

cheerful.li: I'm doing {SUBJECT}! I'm doing {SUBJECT} right now! While talking to you!

gloomy.li: For a few hours I wasn't thinking about anything else. That's a gift, out here.

cold.li: Correct allocation. You'll see the results.

plain.li: [promised] I was supposed to be doing {SUBJECT} by now. I'm still sweeping floors.
Somebody else is still on {SUBJECT}. I'll stop offering.

warm.li: Whoever's doing {SUBJECT} instead, I hope they're enjoying it as much as I would have.
[trusting] I'm sure there's a good reason I'm not on {SUBJECT}. I'd still like to hear it someday.

blunt.li: Fine. Enjoy whatever mess the others make of {SUBJECT}.

cheerful.li: I'll just be the best hauler ever! I'll haul with passion! ...I'll haul.

gloomy.li: [lowmood] Right. Back to being useless, then.

cold.li: Then my skills will rot. That's your loss, not mine.

plain.li: Still not on {SUBJECT}. Still thinking about it every single day.

blunt.li: Just watched {SUBJECT} get done wrong. Again. Put me on it.

cheerful.li: Still ready for {SUBJECT}! Very ready! Look how ready I am!

gloomy.li: [lowmood] I've stopped watching them do {SUBJECT}. It hurts to watch.

warm.li: Whenever you're shuffling the work around, I'd still love a turn at {SUBJECT}.

plain.li: We eat every meal staring at the same blank wall. Something to look at would help the food go down.
[skill:Artistic] I've got a block of stone and an idea. Give me a place where people will actually see it.
[afterraid] After a day like today, I'd like to look up at supper and see something that isn't a bloodstain.
[repeat] The walls haven't gotten any less blank since I last brought it up.

warm.li: Something beautiful where we all eat. Something we can point at and say: we made that, out here.
[winter] The winter is gray enough. Our dining room doesn't need to be.
[grieving] Something beautiful where we eat. To remember the ones who used to eat with us.

blunt.li: The rec room looks like a prison. I've been in prison. Our rec room is worse.
[trait:Greedy] Other colonies have art. We have walls. Embarrassing.
[trait:Abrasive] I don't care about art. I care that the dining room is so ugly it ruins my appetite.

cheerful.li: We need a statue! Of what? Doesn't matter! Something with a big nose!
[highmood] Let's make the dining room so fancy that raiders stop to admire it before they start shooting!

gloomy.li: When we're all dead, whoever finds this place should find something here worth finding.
[lowmood] Blank walls, gray faces. A statue won't fix it. It might help a little.

cold.li: Visitors judge us by our common rooms. Right now they'd judge us poor. Art changes that.
[trait:Psychopath] I don't feel much looking at art. Other people do. That's useful, so let's have some.
[rich] We're wealthy, and it doesn't show. Spend some of it where visitors can see.

plain.li: Someone stopped mid-bite at supper just to look at it. That's what I wanted.
[petition] We all asked for it. Now we all get to argue about what it means.
[promised] The art's up, just as you said. The dining room looks like somewhere people live now.

warm.li: It's lovely. I've caught people smiling at it when they think nobody's watching.

blunt.li: Fine. It's good. Don't ask me to explain why.

cheerful.li: [evening] I gave it a name at supper! Nobody agreed! It's still called that!

gloomy.li: Something in this place that isn't trying to survive. It just stands there, being nice.

cold.li: Morale should rise measurably. I'll be watching to see if it does.

plain.li: [promised] The wall's still waiting for its art. So am I.
I'll scratch something into the dining table, then. Don't look.
[skill:Artistic] I'll carve something myself, then. Don't blame me if it comes out angry.

warm.li: The people are the nicest thing in that room anyway. I'll look at them.

blunt.li: Back to eating in a gray box. Lovely.

cheerful.li: I'll stand very still in the corner of the dining room! I'm the art now!

gloomy.li: Nothing beautiful lasts out here. I don't know why I thought this would.

cold.li: Unfortunate. The cheapest morale improvement available, ignored.

plain.li: Still staring at blank walls at supper. Just mentioning {WISH}.

warm.li: [petition] A few of us keep looking at that empty corner of the dining room and thinking the same thing.

cheerful.li: I've picked the perfect spot for the statue! It's in front of the wall! The blank one!

gloomy.li: [evening] Another supper with the bare walls. I've started seeing faces in the stone.

blunt.li: Dining room's still ugly. In case anyone's forgotten.

plain.li: [trigger:raid] It failed me twice in that fight. The third time, I'm dead. A proper {SUBJECT}, please.
[trait:Brawler] They keep handing me things that shoot. I don't shoot. I hit. Get me something heavy.
[skill:Shooting,!trait:Brawler] I can shoot. This thing can't. I'd like a {SUBJECT} that keeps up with me.
[repeat] Funny thing: my weapon didn't fix itself while you were deciding.

warm.li: I'm not after glory. I just want to be able to stand in front of the others when it matters.
[afterraid] I saw who they went for today. Next time I want to stop them. A real {SUBJECT}, please.
[trait:Kind] I don't like fighting. But if I have to, I'd rather it was over fast. A decent {SUBJECT} does that.

blunt.li: This thing I carry is an insult to the person I took it from.
[trait:Bloodlust] I want something that makes them scream. Is that a strange thing to want? Don't answer.

cheerful.li: I've been practicing my battle cry! It deserves a better {SUBJECT}!
[skill:Melee] Give me a real {SUBJECT} and I'll make the next raid a story worth telling!
[trait:Bloodlust] A better {SUBJECT} means more fun! For me! Less for them!

gloomy.li: When I go, I'd like it to be because they were better. Not because my weapon was worse.
[hurt] Look at me. This is what this weapon got me.
[afterraid] A raider's weapon outclassed mine all afternoon. I lived anyway. Next time I won't.

cold.li: The raiders carry better equipment than I do. That should be the other way round. Arrange it.
[trigger:raid] One of them got away today because of this weapon. I don't like leaving things unfinished.

plain.li: Feels right in my hands. Like it was waiting for me.
[afterraid] Next time they come, they'll meet this. Good.
[promised] Next raid, you'll see exactly what keeping your promise bought.

warm.li: I'll keep it clean, and I'll keep everyone safe. Thank you.

blunt.li: [trait:Bloodlust] Oh, they're going to hate this. I'm going to love it.

cheerful.li: I took it for a walk around the perimeter! Twice! It's excellent company!

gloomy.li: Maybe I'll survive the next one now. Maybe.

cold.li: Good balance. Good weight. The next raid will be shorter.

plain.li: [promised] So it's this junk again for the next raid. I hope it holds.
[trigger:raid] I'll take something off a dead raider next time. It's quicker than waiting.

warm.li: It's alright. I'll stand in front of everyone anyway. Just not as well.

blunt.li: When I'm out there swinging junk, think of me.
[bitter] Great. I'll die holding junk and you'll keep your silver.

cheerful.li: This old thing has character! And rust! Mostly rust!

gloomy.li: [lowmood] Well. If this gets me killed, at least it'll be quick. Hopefully.

cold.li: Accepted. My kill rate stays where it is. So does theirs.

plain.li: [trigger:raid] Still carrying the junk I fought with last time. About that {SUBJECT}...

blunt.li: They'll be back. This won't hold. Get me a decent {SUBJECT}.

cheerful.li: My battle cry is ready! My weapon is not! Hint!

gloomy.li: [night] Cleaned this sorry weapon again tonight. Still sorry.

cold.li: My weapon remains substandard. Raids do not wait for procurement.

plain.li: We grow food, we make clothes, we bury our dead. We don't brew. Feels like we skipped a step.
[trait:DrugDesire] It's been a long time since I had anything at all. Beer is the gentle option. Think about it.
[fall] The harvest's in. It'd be a shame not to turn some of it into something worth drinking.
[repeat] The harvests keep coming in and none of it is becoming beer. I'm bringing it up again.

warm.li: A barrel of our own beer would be something to share. With traders, with guests, with each other.
[evening] Picture it: everyone around the fire, a mug each, and nobody talking about raids.
[winter] A mug of our own beer by the fire on a winter night. That would carry a lot of us through.

blunt.li: I'm not asking for anything strong. I'm asking for beer. Be glad it's only beer.
[afterraid] We survived today and toasted with water. Water. Build {THING}.

cheerful.li: I've already designed the label for our beer! It's a muffalo, winking! Please build {THING}!
[summer] Hot day, cold beer. That's the whole pitch! Can we?
[highmood] Good days deserve a toast! We currently have nothing to toast with!

gloomy.li: We'll all be dead one day. I'd like to have had a drink first.
[lowmood] One beer. One evening where things feel far away. Is that so much?

cold.li: Traders pay well for beer. So do colonists, in good behavior. Two returns on one barrel.
[trait:Psychopath] Drunk people are easier to read. I like a colony I can read. Let's brew.
[trait:DrugDesire] I can control myself. A barrel here at home keeps me from looking elsewhere.

plain.li: First batch is in the barrel. I keep checking on it like it's a newborn.
[petition] Everyone who asked gets the first mug. That's only fair.
[promised] A barrel, like you promised. I'll name the first batch after the council.

warm.li: I'll pour the first round myself when it's ready. For everyone who helped.

blunt.li: Good. Nobody touches it until it's ready. Especially not me.

cheerful.li: [evening] I've been sitting next to the barrel, telling it it's doing great! Encouragement matters!

gloomy.li: Something to wait for that isn't a raid. That's new.

cold.li: Production has begun. I'll be calculating the yield per colonist.

plain.li: [promised] A promised brewery. I'll just drink the promise, then.
No beer. Back to muddy water, and pretending it's aged.
[evening] Another evening, another cup of water. I've started making toasts to it out of spite.

warm.li: We'll toast with whatever's in the cup. It's the toasting that counts.

blunt.li: [bitter] Can't even manage a barrel. Is there anything this council can build?

cheerful.li: Fine by me! I'll make "beer" out of berries and hope! Mostly hope!

gloomy.li: A long dry season ahead, then. They're all long and dry here.

cold.li: Disappointing. Morale will fall faster than it needed to. I'll watch it happen.

plain.li: Still no beer. A barrel would take one afternoon. I've measured.

blunt.li: Brewery. Remember? The thing that makes beer? We still don't have one.

cheerful.li: [evening] Every evening I think: this is the perfect time for a beer! Every single evening!

gloomy.li: [lowmood] Still dry. Still hoping. Mostly dry.

warm.li: [petition] A few of us are still dreaming about that first mug. Just saying.

plain.li: [trigger:rawfood] I chewed a raw muffalo steak for ten minutes and lost the fight.
[trigger:sick] Whoever cooked yesterday, I forgive you. My stomach doesn't. Could we have {SUBJECT}, made properly?
[industrial|spacer] We've got machines that can do almost anything, and we eat like we crashed here yesterday. I'd like {SUBJECT}.
[repeat] I'm bringing up {SUBJECT} again because I'm still eating like a scavenger.

warm.li: The cooks work so hard. If they had time for {SUBJECT}, I think it would cheer them up too.
[old] I'd like a warm meal that doesn't fight back. My teeth aren't what they were.
[grieving] Food is the only thing that's felt like comfort lately. Good food would feel like more.

blunt.li: [trigger:rawfood] Raw again. I'm not a muffalo. Cook something.
[trait:Gourmand] I'll cook it myself if I have to, and nobody wants that. Get the cooks making {SUBJECT}.

cheerful.li: If we have {SUBJECT} tonight, I'll do the dishes for a week! Two weeks!
[trigger:sick] Good news: I've stopped throwing up! Bad news: I'm starving! Could we have {SUBJECT}?
[highmood] I'm so happy today! Know what would make it perfect? Eating {SUBJECT}!

gloomy.li: I don't remember what food is supposed to taste like. Something other than this, I think.
[trigger:rawfood] Eating raw food like an animal. All this way, for this.

cold.li: [trigger:sick] Food poisoning took me off work for a day. A clean kitchen and {SUBJECT} prevent that.
Good food keeps people agreeable. I like agreeable people. They're easier to manage.
[trait:Gourmand] I can tell when a cook is being lazy. Ours is being lazy. I want {SUBJECT}.

plain.li: I ate slowly for once. I didn't want it to end.
[trigger:rawfood] Hot, cooked, seasoned. My jaw thanks you. So does the rest of me.
[promised] You promised {SUBJECT}. I ate two. Promise kept, twice.

warm.li: Tell the cook it was wonderful. Actually, I'll tell them myself.

blunt.li: [trait:Gourmand] Finally. Real food. Don't stop now.

cheerful.li: [evening] I licked the plate! In public! No regrets!

gloomy.li: [trigger:sick] Food that won't make me sick. I'd forgotten that was an option.

cold.li: Better food, better output. Thank the cook. Keep the cook.

plain.li: [promised] I was expecting {SUBJECT}. I got a handful of raw berries. I don't think that's what anyone meant.
Back to eating whatever's quickest and least likely to kill me.

warm.li: The cooks have enough on their plates already. I'll manage.
[trigger:rawfood] I'll ask the cook to teach me something simple. Better than chewing it raw.

blunt.li: [trigger:sick] Great. Back to playing food roulette with my stomach.

cheerful.li: Raw food is just food that's very shy!

gloomy.li: Same food tomorrow. Same food the day after. That's how it'll be until the end.

cold.li: Then morale will keep falling at mealtimes. I've stopped expecting otherwise.

plain.li: [trigger:rawfood] Ate raw again today. Any news on {SUBJECT}?

warm.li: [petition] A lot of us would love {SUBJECT}, even just once.

blunt.li: [trait:Gourmand] Still eating slop. Still remembering what flavor was.

cheerful.li: I keep imagining {SUBJECT}! In detail! Please hurry, the details are getting very detailed!

gloomy.li: [lowmood] Another meal of nothing. I'm starting not to notice. That's worse.

plain.li: I threw out a whole crate of berries this morning. Fuzzy ones. We need cold storage.
[skill:Cooking] I can't plan a single meal when half the pantry rots before the week's out.
[summer] The flies have moved into the storeroom. They've invited friends. We need a freezer.
[repeat] Since I last asked, we've thrown out enough food to feed a caravan.

warm.li: [skill:Plants] I grew all that food with my own hands. I'd hate to watch it rot. A freezer, please?
If we lose the harvest to spoilage, we'll go hungry by winter. I'd rather none of us did.
[skill:Cooking] I'd love to cook with fresh ingredients for once. It's the difference between a meal and a ration.
