blunt.li: [summer] Something in the storeroom is moving, and it isn't a squirrel. Build a freezer.
I'm done picking maggots out of dinner. Freezer. Now.

cheerful.li: A freezer means ice! And ice means... well, I'm sure it means something fun! Let's find out!
[hot] It's so hot out! A freezer would be the coolest room in the colony! Literally!
[spring] Let's build a freezer before summer hits! Future us will be so grateful!

gloomy.li: Everything here rots eventually. The food's just faster about it.
[summer] Food rots in summer and we starve in winter. It's not complicated.
[lowmood] Opened the storeroom and the smell hit me like a sledgehammer. I just closed the door again.

cold.li: If we run short this winter, we'll have to decide who eats. I'd rather skip that conversation. A freezer, please.
[trait:Psychopath] Cold keeps meat fresh for a very long time. Any kind of meat. A freezer is practical.

plain.li: I walked in and the meat didn't look back at me. Perfect.
[summer] Midsummer and the food's still good. That's never happened here before.
[promised] The food's fresh and the flies are furious. Thank you for keeping your word.

warm.li: Nothing we grow will go to waste now. Thank you.

blunt.li: Good. Nobody leaves that door open. I'll know.

cheerful.li: [hot] The freezer is my new favorite place to stand! Don't mind me!

gloomy.li: We might actually make it through the winter now. Might.

cold.li: Spoilage eliminated. I'll take inventory regularly. Nobody takes extra.

plain.li: [promised] We were meant to have a freezer. The meat didn't wait for it.
I'll eat the oldest food first and pray, then.
[summer] I threw out another crate this morning. I'm not even angry anymore. Just tired.

warm.li: I'll dry what I can, then. Every bit saved helps.

blunt.li: [summer] Enjoy the smell, then. I'm eating outside.

cheerful.li: Fresh food tastes best anyway! Within the first hour! Eat fast, everyone!

gloomy.li: Watch it rot, then. We're all good at watching things rot here.

cold.li: Then we'll lose food, and after that we'll lose people. In that order.

plain.li: [summer] More food went off this morning. Still hoping for {WISH}.

warm.li: [petition] Everyone who works in the kitchen is still asking. The food's still spoiling.

blunt.li: Smell that? That's another meal nobody froze.

cheerful.li: I found something growing on the bread! Not in a good way! Freezer, please!

gloomy.li: [lowmood] Something else rotted today. I didn't even look to see what.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} asked. I said yes. Now all we need is a quiet day and somewhere to stand.
[summer] A summer wedding, before the harvest. Short and sweet, like the season.
[old] I never thought I'd marry, at my age. {OTHER_nameDef} changed my mind. Let's not wait.
[repeat] I'm asking again. {OTHER_nameDef} has started picking flowers just in case.

warm.li: I'd like everyone there. Even the ones who don't like weddings. Especially them.
[grieving] We've lost people. I'd like one day where we gain something instead. {OTHER_nameDef} and I could give everyone that.
[trusting] You've looked after us so well. Give us one day, and we'll make it a good one for everyone.

blunt.li: We're engaged, not dead. Let's get on with it.
[trait:Abrasive] I'm marrying {OTHER_nameDef}. Anyone who objects can say so at the ceremony and see what happens.
[winter] Snow wedding, then. Cold hands, short vows. Just name the day.

cheerful.li: I've picked the spot! And the flowers! And the song! I just need one day without raiders!
[spring] Spring wedding! Flowers on everyone! Even the muffalo! Especially the muffalo!
[highmood] I'm so happy I could marry {OTHER_nameDef} today! Can I? Is today good?

gloomy.li: Every day I wait to marry {OTHER_nameDef} is another day for something to go wrong.
[lowmood] Everything's falling apart. I'd like to marry {OTHER_nameDef} before it finishes.

cold.li: Marriage makes it formal. {OTHER_nameDef} will be mine, officially. I'd like that settled.
[trait:Psychopath] I don't entirely understand weddings. {OTHER_nameDef} wants one. I want {OTHER_nameDef} content. It's simple.

plain.li: I keep looking at {OTHER_nameDef} and thinking: married. Out here. Us.
[evening] We danced. Badly. Nobody cared. Best night on the rim.
[promised] You kept your word, and {OTHER_nameDef} kept a flower from the day. We'll keep both.

warm.li: Thank you for giving us the day. {OTHER_nameDef} cried. So did I.

blunt.li: Married. Good. Now nobody look at {OTHER_nameDef} funny.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I are MARRIED and I'm going to say "my spouse" every chance I get!

gloomy.li: Whatever happens next, we did this. Nobody can take this one.

cold.li: Formalized, and done properly. It mattered to me more than I expected.

plain.li: [promised] We were told we'd have our wedding. The flowers we picked have wilted.
{OTHER_nameDef} says we'll find another day. I hope there is one.
[afterraid] Another raid, another wedding put off. {OTHER_nameDef} keeps the flowers in water anyway.

warm.li: It's alright. We don't need a ceremony to mean it. We'd just have liked one.

blunt.li: Fine. We'll get married behind the stockpile with a muffalo for a witness. Thanks for nothing.

cheerful.li: Longer engagement! More time to practice the vows! I'm on my ninth draft!

gloomy.li: We waited too long. That's how it goes here. You always wait too long.

cold.li: The delay has upset {OTHER_nameDef}. I don't like it when {OTHER_nameDef} is upset. Remember that.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I are still engaged. Still waiting for a calm day and a place to stand.

warm.li: [evening] {OTHER_nameDef} asked me again tonight when the wedding would be. I didn't have an answer.

cheerful.li: I've practiced my vows on the animals! They loved them! Can we have the wedding now?

gloomy.li: [afterraid] Another close call. Still no wedding. How many more of those do we get?

blunt.li: Still engaged. Still waiting. Still not getting any younger.

plain.li: My birthday's coming. Another year survived on this rock. I'd like to mark it with a {SUBJECT}.
[teen] I'm almost grown, apparently. Does that count for a {SUBJECT}?
[newcomer] My first birthday here. I'd like it to feel like I belong.
[repeat] Last year I asked for a {SUBJECT} too. Let's make this the year it happens.

warm.li: I'd love a {SUBJECT}, but mostly I'd love an evening where everyone's together and nobody's hurt.
[old] I suspect there aren't many birthdays left in me. I'd like this one to have good food in it.
[grieving] It's my first birthday without someone I loved. I'd like the rest of you close.

blunt.li: A year older and not a silver richer. A {SUBJECT} would even it out.
[trait:Gourmand] It's my birthday. That means the good ingredients. Don't argue.
[afterraid] We survived a raid. I survived another year. That's two reasons for a {SUBJECT}.

cheerful.li: I've already planned the menu, the guests and my speech! It's a long speech! Can I have a {SUBJECT}?
[child] I'm going to be SO old! Like, one more! Can I have a {SUBJECT}?
[spring] A spring birthday! Everything's growing, including me! A {SUBJECT}, please!

gloomy.li: Another year closer to the dirt. Might as well eat something nice on the way.
[lowmood] Nobody needs to make a fuss. A {SUBJECT} would be nice. Or not. Whatever.

cold.li: Birthdays reaffirm a person's value to the group. I'd like mine reaffirmed. A {SUBJECT} will do.
[trait:Psychopath] Birthdays mean nothing to me. They mean a great deal to the others, and the others watch how you treat me.

plain.li: A year older and I don't even mind. Thank you.
[evening] Everyone sang. Out of tune. I'll never forget it.
[promised] I didn't think anyone would really remember. You did. Thank you.

warm.li: Everyone came. That was the real present.

blunt.li: Good food, good company, nobody died. Best birthday on the rim.

cheerful.li: [child] Best birthday EVER! I'm going to stay this age forever!

gloomy.li: For one evening I didn't think about how many more I'll get.

cold.li: Acknowledged and celebrated. I'll remember who came.

plain.li: My birthday came and went, like any other day. Like the next one will.
[promised] I was told there'd be a {SUBJECT}. I ate leftovers and blew out a candle by myself.

warm.li: I got older all the same. That's the important part, I suppose.
[child] That's okay. I had a birthday in my head. It was nice in there.

blunt.li: Happy birthday to me. From me. Since nobody else bothered.

cheerful.li: I'll just have my birthday again tomorrow! And the day after! Until somebody notices!

gloomy.li: [lowmood] Another year. Nobody noticed. I barely did.

cold.li: So my birthday is not considered relevant. I'll treat yours the same way.

plain.li: My birthday's nearly here. Still hoping for a {SUBJECT}.

blunt.li: Birthday's soon. Feast or party, your choice. Either beats nothing.

cheerful.li: Only a few days till my birthday! Just reminding everyone! Every hour!

gloomy.li: [lowmood] It's fine if nobody remembers my birthday. I'm only mentioning it so somebody does.

warm.li: [old] At my age, birthdays feel important. Just a small reminder about mine.

plain.li: I'd like to wake up and see something someone made with care. Even something small.
[skill:Artistic] I'd like someone else's work in my room for once. I'm sick of looking at my own.
[winter] Months indoors staring at the same stone. A sculpture would give my eyes somewhere to go.
[repeat] My walls are still blank, and I'm still lying in bed looking at them.

warm.li: If someone's carving something anyway, I'd love it if it could live in my room.
[old] I'd like one beautiful thing to look at in the evenings. At my age, the evenings are long.
[grieving] Something beautiful to look at when I miss them. That's what I'd want it for.

blunt.li: We keep sculptures in the storeroom like they're potatoes. Put one in my room.
[trait:Jealous] I've seen the statue in someone else's room. I'd like one. A bigger one.
[trait:Greedy] I want something on my wall that's worth more than I am. I'll feel richer just looking at it.

cheerful.li: Art in my room means I'm basically a museum! Admission is free! Visitors welcome!
[highmood] Today's a good day, and good days deserve a good sculpture!
[spring] Something to celebrate spring in my room! A sculpture of a flower! Or a flower! Or a sculpture!

gloomy.li: Something beautiful, so the last thing I see each night isn't a wall.
[lowmood] Maybe if I had something lovely to look at, I'd stop staring at the ceiling.

cold.li: I'd like a piece in my room. A good one. People should see what I'm worth when they walk in.
[trait:Psychopath] Other people cry at sculptures. I'd like one in my room to study, every night, until I understand why.

plain.li: I sat and looked at it for an hour. Didn't think about anything else.
[morning] First thing I see when I wake up. Better than a wall. Much better than a wall.
[promised] I'd stopped believing it would come. Then it came. Thank you.

warm.li: Whoever made it, I'd like to thank them. It's beautiful.

blunt.li: Good. Nobody touches it. Nobody even breathes on it.

cheerful.li: I keep popping back to my room just to say hello to it!

gloomy.li: It's lovely. I don't know what I did to deserve something lovely.

cold.li: Competent work. It suits me. I'll keep it.

plain.li: No art, then. I'll hang my coat on the wall and squint at it.
[promised] Something beautiful, I was promised. The wall is still just a wall.
[lowmood] Bare walls again tonight. Matches the inside of my head.

warm.li: Maybe someday a piece will turn up that nobody else wants. I'll wait for that one.

blunt.li: My room stays ugly, then. So does my mood.

cheerful.li: I drew a face on the wall with charcoal! It's art if you're generous!

gloomy.li: Beautiful things are for other people. I knew that.

cold.li: I'll remember whose rooms got the art.

plain.li: My walls are still bare. Just mentioning the sculpture.

warm.li: If there's ever a spare piece in the storeroom, my room would give it a good home.

cheerful.li: I've cleared a spot for the art! I dust the spot every day! It's a very clean spot!

gloomy.li: [night] Lying in bed, staring at the same bare wall. Still hoping.

blunt.li: Still no art in my room. I'm getting very good at describing the wall.

plain.li: I fell asleep standing up at the stockpile, leaning on a crate. I'd like a few hours off.
[summer] It's too nice out to spend every hour hauling. Give me one afternoon in the sun.
[hurt] I'm still healing and I'm still working full days. A little rest, please.
[repeat] I'm more tired now than the last time I asked.

warm.li: I'd like an hour to sit with friends and not be useful for once.
[trusting] I know there's always more work. I trust you to know when I need a break. I think I need one.
[grieving] I've been working so I don't have to think. I think I need to stop and think, just for a bit.

blunt.li: I've worked every hour the sun's up and a few it isn't. Give me time off, or I take it.
[trait:Abrasive] Everyone's annoying me. That usually means I need a break. Before they need one from me.

cheerful.li: I want an afternoon to lie in the grass and do absolutely nothing! I've been practicing!
[spring] Spring's here! The flowers are out! I'd like to be out too, not hauling stone!
[highmood] I'm in a wonderful mood! Let me spend it somewhere other than the stockpile!

gloomy.li: My hands shake by evening. I don't think that's normal. Some rest might help.
[lowmood] I'm so tired I've stopped noticing I'm tired. That's when it goes bad.

cold.li: I've worked more hours this month than anyone here. I'd like that balanced. With rest, preferably.
[trait:Psychopath] I don't need rest. My temper does. You'd prefer my temper rested.
[trait:Industriousness] Rest is wasted time, normally. My hands have started shaking, so call it maintenance.

plain.li: I sat in the sun and did nothing. I'm going to do it again tomorrow.
[evening] A whole evening to myself. I didn't know what to do with it, so I did nothing. Perfect.
[promised] Time to myself, as promised. I slept through all of it. Worth it.

warm.li: I spent my free hour with friends. I'd missed them, and they were right there all along.

blunt.li: Good. Don't come looking for me during my hours.

cheerful.li: I took a nap so good I woke up not knowing what year it was!

gloomy.li: I slept, and I woke up, and I didn't dread it. Thank you.

cold.li: Rested. My work will be cleaner now.

plain.li: [promised] I was promised some rest. I'm too tired to be angry about it. Maybe tomorrow.
I'll rest when I'm dead. Which, at this rate...
[hurt] Back to work, still healing. I'm sure that'll go fine.

warm.li: Everyone's working hard. I can keep up a while longer.

blunt.li: When I nap in the middle of a field, don't wake me.

cheerful.li: No break? I'll take tiny breaks! Between steps! Very small ones!

gloomy.li: [lowmood] Work, then. Always work. Until something breaks. Probably me.

cold.li: Then expect the quality of my work to reflect my condition.

plain.li: Still working every hour there is. Still hoping for a few of them back.

blunt.li: Nearly fell asleep with a knife in my hand today. Just mentioning it.

cheerful.li: I've planned my time off in detail! Step one: lie down! There is no step two!

gloomy.li: [night] Still awake, and up again in a few hours. About {WISH}...

warm.li: I'm still running on very little. A few hours off, whenever you can manage it.

plain.li: A joint, a beer, anything. Something to sit with at the end of the day.
[trait:DrugDesire] I'm not going to do anything stupid. I'd just like the option of something mild in the stockpile.
[storm] Thunder all night and nothing to settle the nerves. Some smokeleaf, maybe? A beer?
[repeat] Back again about the stockpile. It's still dry. So am I.

warm.li: Something to pass around at the end of a hard week. It brings people closer. Honestly.
[grieving] I'd like to raise a glass to the ones we've lost. We don't have anything to put in the glass.
[trusting] I know you'll be sensible about it. Just a little, for when things get hard.

blunt.li: Everyone's on edge. I know a cure. It comes in a barrel or a roll. Get some.
[bitter] You want me less bitter? Give me something to drink. It's the cheapest fix you've got.

cheerful.li: Let's have a little party! Just a tiny one! With a tiny bit of beer! Or a big bit!
[evening] Evenings are for stories and a little something to sip! We've already got the stories!
[highmood] Great mood, great company, no drinks! One of those things should change!

gloomy.li: Some nights I need the edges filed off. Tonight's one of those.
[lowmood] Nothing helps much anymore. A drink helps a little. A little is something.

cold.li: Mild intoxicants keep people compliant through bad weeks. This is a bad week.
[trait:Psychopath] I don't need it. The others do, and I have to live with the others.
[trait:DrugDesire] A small, controlled supply now prevents a large, uncontrolled one later. Think about it.

plain.li: One drink, one evening, nobody fighting. Good trade.
[evening] Sitting by the fire with a mug and nothing to do. Exactly right.
[promised] A little something, like you said. Cheers to the council.

warm.li: I'll share it around. That was always the point.

blunt.li: Ah. Nobody talk to me for an hour.

cheerful.li: Cheers! To everyone! To this mug! To the next mug!

gloomy.li: The edges are blurred for a while. I needed that more than I said.

cold.li: Stock replenished. Tensions should drop. I'll be watching who drinks the most.

plain.li: Dry, then. I'll survive. Grumpily.
[promised] A little something, I was promised. I got a little nothing.
[evening] Another dry evening. I've started telling stories about beer instead.

warm.li: We'll sit around the fire anyway. Good company does most of the work.

blunt.li: [trait:DrugDesire] Fine. I know where the traders camp. Don't ask what I'll trade.

cheerful.li: I'll toast with water! Cheers, water! You're very wet!

gloomy.li: Sober nights are the longest. Every single one of them.

cold.li: Tempers will fray faster now. I'll stay clear of whoever breaks first.

plain.li: [evening] Another evening with nothing to drink. Still asking about {WISH}.

blunt.li: The stockpile's still dry. You've noticed, right?

cheerful.li: I've saved a spot on the shelf for a little something! It's a lonely spot!

gloomy.li: [lowmood] It's getting harder to wind down at night. Just so you know.

warm.li: [trusting] Not trying to nag. Still hoping for a little something in the stockpile, that's all.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} fixed the hinge on the cell door. From the inside. Then didn't use it. That counts for something.
[night] I heard {OTHER_nameDef} crying in the cell last night. That isn't an enemy. That's a lost person.
[newcomer] I was a stranger here not long ago. Give {OTHER_nameDef} the same chance you gave me.
[repeat] Nothing's changed since I last asked about {OTHER_nameDef}, except that I know {OTHER_objective} better now.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} knows all our names now, and asks how we're doing. That isn't how prisoners talk.
[trait:Kind] I bring {OTHER_nameDef} food sometimes and we talk. There's a good person in that cell.
[trusting] You've trusted my judgment before. Trust it on {OTHER_nameDef}.

blunt.li: We need hands. {OTHER_nameDef} has two good ones. Stop dithering.
[afterraid] Today proved we need more fighters, and {OTHER_nameDef} is sitting in a cell doing nothing.
[trait:Abrasive] I don't like many people. I like {OTHER_nameDef}. Think about what that means.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I are already friends! Through the bars! It would be easier without the bars!
[highmood] Let's make a new friend today! {OTHER_nameDef} is right there! Locked in place, even!
[spring] Everything's starting over this season! {OTHER_nameDef} could start over too! With us!

gloomy.li: We were all strangers once. Some of us were worse than {OTHER_nameDef}.
[grieving] There are empty seats at our table now. {OTHER_nameDef} won't replace anyone, but a seat shouldn't stay empty forever.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} eats our food either way. Better {OTHER_nameDef} works for it.
[trait:Psychopath] I've considered every option for {OTHER_nameDef}: recruit, release, harvest. Recruit is the most efficient. This time.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is one of us now. I'll show {OTHER_objective} around.
[evening] {OTHER_nameDef} ate supper with us tonight instead of through the bars. Good.
[promised] You said you'd give {OTHER_nameDef} a chance. Look how that turned out.

warm.li: I knew there was someone worth knowing in there. Welcome, {OTHER_nameDef}.

blunt.li: About time. {OTHER_nameDef} can haul like the rest of us now.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} joined! I'm throwing a party! A small one! {OTHER_nameDef} is invited!

gloomy.li: Another one of us. Another one to lose. ...Welcome, {OTHER_nameDef}. I mean it.

cold.li: A sound decision. I'll keep an eye on {OTHER_nameDef}. For everyone's sake.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is still behind bars. I've stopped visiting. It's easier.
[promised] Somebody was going to try with {OTHER_nameDef}. I don't think anybody did.

warm.li: I'll keep bringing {OTHER_nameDef} food and talking. Someone should.
[night] I told {OTHER_nameDef} not to give up. I'm not sure I believed it.

blunt.li: Keep feeding a prisoner forever, then. Very smart.

cheerful.li: Long-distance friendship! Very long! About one cell door's worth!

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} will rot in there, or leave, or die. None of those include us.

cold.li: Unfortunate. {OTHER_nameDef} was a resource. Now {OTHER_nameDef} is a mouth.

plain.li: I talked with {OTHER_nameDef} again today. I still think we should bring {OTHER_objective} in.

warm.li: [night] {OTHER_nameDef} asked me tonight whether anyone had decided anything. I said soon. Was I lying?

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is still in the cell, still eating our food. Decide something.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} doesn't get more valuable sitting in a cell. Sooner is better.

gloomy.li: [lowmood] {OTHER_nameDef} has stopped asking me about it. That's worse than asking.
